composition_label: Structured extraction -> Feedback analysis -> Journey recommendations

construction.implementation_origin: New implementation authored in the isolated build directory; no existing source read or copied.

input.fixture_label: Nonblank provenance label; supplied fixture explicitly marked SYNTHETIC.
input.documents: Up to 100 unique {id, text} documents, with at most 100000 Unicode characters each.
input.field_schema: Up to 50 {name, label, type, required} declarations. Unique names and labels. String fields customer, feedback and goal must be declared. Additional fields supported. Types: string and integer.
input.themes: Up to 100 {id, keywords} definitions; keywords use normalized whole-word phrase matching.
input.actions: Up to 100 unique {id, title, prerequisites, theme_ids} definitions, validated for references and acyclic prerequisites.
input.profile: {completed_action_ids}: distinct known action IDs asserted already complete.

output.stage_envelopes: Every stage includes schema_version and stage.
output.extraction: Documents contain typed fields with source spans, missing_fields and missing_required_fields.
output.feedback: Deduplicated items retain every occurrence and extracted customer/goal context. Themes retain feedback IDs and all supporting source excerpts. Unmatched items, skipped documents and duplicate_count are explicit.
output.journey: Status ready or blocked; all immediately eligible next_actions, validated two-step steps or empty steps with reason. Recommendations include score, theme IDs and supporting feedback IDs.
output.errors: {status: error, error: message}; stdout JSON, exit 2.

shared_schema.validation: Single validate(stage, payload, data, previous) boundary rejects unexpected keys and invalid input references. Deterministic stage outputs are rederived from validated preceding-stage output and compared recursively with exact types, checking all spans, provenance, missing-field lists, deduplication, ranking and prerequisites.

cross_stage_handoffs.contract: Feedback analysis first validates extraction, then consumes only its typed feedback field, source span and extracted customer/goal context. It does not independently extract source documents.
Journey first validates feedback against extraction. Theme-to-feedback references determine action evidence and scores; input action definitions and completed actions constrain eligibility.

behavior.extraction: Exact case-sensitive label at line start followed by a colon. Single-line value trimmed; duplicate labels rejected, blank or absent fields reported missing. Integer values accept an optional sign and 1-18 ASCII digits. Unknown source lines ignored. Required-field absence remains a visible diagnostic, not a fabricated value or fatal error.
behavior.spans: Half-open [start, end) Python Unicode character offsets into original, unnormalized document text; excerpts reproduce the referenced text exactly.
behavior.deduplication: NFKC, casefold, Unicode word tokens joined by single spaces. Punctuation and whitespace differences deduplicate globally while preserving all document occurrences. IDs follow first encounter order. Empty word content is explicitly skipped.
behavior.themes: Deterministic configured whole-word or phrase matching; multi-theme matches allowed. Excerpts are complete extracted feedback values, not generated summaries.
behavior.recommendations: Score is distinct deduplicated feedback IDs supporting an action's matched themes. Enumerate all valid two-action sequences. Rank by total per-step score, then first-step score, then lexical action IDs. The same evidence may support both steps. Prerequisites may be already complete or completed by step one. Zero-evidence actions are allowed as explicit catalog fallback. Missing two-step candidates produce blocked status, never a fabricated or partial journey.
behavior.determinism: No randomness, live providers or LLM steps. No input mutation. The same input order produces byte-stable JSON output.
behavior.cli: Exactly one input file argument. UTF-8 JSON only; duplicate JSON keys and nonstandard numeric constants rejected. Successful pipeline status is ok even when journey is blocked. Errors are a single JSON object with exit 2.

included: One integrated runnable CLI and one shared validation layer
Schema-driven line-oriented extraction with source provenance
Deduplication, configured themes and traceable supporting excerpts
Evidence-ranked next actions and validated two-step prerequisite-aware journeys
Synthetic fixture and unittest coverage including CLI subprocesses
excluded: Live LLMs, optional provider adapters and networks
PDF, OCR, multiline or free-form semantic extraction
Automatic prerequisite completion or inference of missing facts
Per-customer separate journeys; this reference ranks feedback for one supplied profile

covered: Schema-driven extraction, integer conversion, dynamic fields and missing-field reporting
Exact Unicode and CRLF source spans, blank values and repeated-label rejection
Normalization, deduplication, retained contexts, whole-word themes and supporting excerpts
Cross-stage content propagation and tampered-handoff rejection
Completed actions, prerequisites, deterministic ranking, blocked journeys and empty data
Invalid schemas, references, cycles, strict JSON parsing and file errors
CLI subprocess success, malformed JSON, invalid schema, missing file and usage errors
